title: post api auth signup create new user account
description: Test POST /api/auth/signup with valid name, email, password. Expect 201 with JWT token and user object with role SUBACCOUNT_USER. Test duplicate email returns 409. Test missing name returns 400. Test missing email returns 400. Test missing password returns 400.

title: post api auth signin authenticate user and get jwt
description: Test POST /api/auth/signin with email=test_pawal@yopmail.com password=Wlink123. Expect 200 with token string, user object with id, name, email, role=AGENCY_OWNER. Test wrong password returns 401. Test nonexistent email returns 401. Test missing fields returns 400.

title: get api auth me return current user profile with role
description: Test GET /api/auth/me with valid Authorization: Bearer <JWT>. Expect 200 with user id, name, email, role. Test missing Authorization header returns 401. Test invalid/garbage token returns 401. Test expired token returns 401. Validates role-based identity: the returned role should be AGENCY_OWNER for our test user.

title: post api auth forgot password anti enumeration
description: Test POST /api/auth/forgot-password with known email test_pawal@yopmail.com. Expect 200 with success message. Test with completely unknown email randomxyz@nowhere.com also returns 200 (anti-enumeration). Test missing email field returns 400.

title: post api auth verify otp with invalid otp
description: Test POST /api/auth/verify-otp with invalid OTP code 000000 and email test_pawal@yopmail.com. Expect 400 with error about invalid OTP. Test missing email returns 400. Test missing otp returns 400.

title: post api auth reset password with invalid token
description: Test POST /api/auth/reset-password with fake resetToken=invalid_token_123 and newPassword=NewPass123. Expect 400 with error about invalid or expired token. Test missing resetToken returns 400. Test missing newPassword returns 400.

title: post api contact messages submit and validate fields
description: Test POST /api/contact-messages with valid JSON {name:'Test', email:'test@test.com', message:'Hello'}. Expect 200 with success:true. Test with optional subject field. Test missing name returns 400. Test missing email returns 400. Test missing message returns 400. Test empty body returns 400.

title: post api contact messages reply requires auth
description: Test POST /api/contact-messages/reply without auth cookie. Expect 401. Test with valid auth_token cookie but missing messageId expect 400.

title: post api chat ai requires auth and validates body
description: Test POST /api/chat/ai without auth. Expect 401. Test with valid auth_token cookie but empty body expect 400 with error 'Content and conversationId are required'. Test with content but missing conversationId expect 400. Test with conversationId but missing content expect 400.

title: post api chat send requires auth and validates body
description: Test POST /api/chat/send without auth. Expect 401. Test with valid auth_token cookie but missing content or conversationId expect 400.

title: get api stripe plan prices public endpoint
description: Test GET /api/stripe/plan-prices without any auth. Expect 200 with object containing plan price mappings. Response should have keys and priceId values.

title: get api plan limits subaccount validation
description: Test GET /api/plan-limits?agencyId=test-id&type=subaccount. Expect 200 with allowed (boolean), currentCount (number), maxAllowed (number), planName (string). Test missing agencyId returns 400. Test missing type returns 400. Test type=teamMember also works.

title: get api media requires subaccountid param
description: Test GET /api/media without subAccountId query param. Expect 400. Test GET /api/media?subAccountId=nonexistent-id. Expect 200 with {media: []} empty array. Response format must be {media: Array}.

title: post api stripe cancel subscription role based access
description: Test POST /api/stripe/cancel-subscription without auth. Expect 401 Unauthorized. Test that only AGENCY_OWNER role can cancel. Send with valid auth_token cookie and body {agencyId: 'fake-id'} expect 403 or 404 if user not member of that agency.

title: post api stripe create subscription session role access
description: Test POST /api/stripe/create-subscription-session without auth. Expect 401. Test with auth but missing agencyId expect 400. Test with auth but missing priceId expect 400. Test with auth but missing successUrl expect 400. Test with auth but missing cancelUrl expect 400.

title: post api stripe create checkout session validation
description: Test POST /api/stripe/create-checkout-session with empty body. Expect 400. Test with missing prices array expect 400. Test with empty prices array [] expect 400. Test with missing subAccountConnectedId expect 400.

title: get api stripe products list by subaccount
description: Test GET /api/stripe/products without subAccountId. Expect 400. Test GET /api/stripe/products?subAccountId=nonexistent-id. Expect 200 with empty products or error. Test GET /api/stripe/products?subAccountId=valid-id&source=local returns local products.

title: post api stripe products create product validation
description: Test POST /api/stripe/products with missing subAccountId. Expect 400. Test with missing name expect 400. Test with missing price expect 400. Test with valid fields: subAccountId, name, price, optional description.

title: delete api stripe products delete validation
description: Test DELETE /api/stripe/products without productId query param. Expect 400. Test DELETE /api/stripe/products?productId=nonexistent-id. Expect 404 or 400.

title: post api auth signin rate limit protection
description: Test rate limiting on POST /api/auth/signin. Send 10 rapid requests with wrong password. Expect some requests to return 429 Too Many Requests after the limit is hit.
